situation (example wording): "Murder victims by offender race in Memphis in 2024" (crimes by the offenders' demographics)
what the app does today: P49: each crime counts once per category of the incident's offenders.
proposed behavior: The default stays P49 (the incident's offenders). The pair-linked reading (only the offenders the victim-offender relationship segment links to that victim, with a "no relationship reported" category) is used only when the question names the pairing ("killed by", "victims of offenders who were ..."), and the answer labels it as such.
exact default or choices offered: Default: P49. Pair-linked only when the question names the pairing, labelled.
why: The two readings give different numbers; the decided one is the default, and the other is never chosen silently.
